function getposition()
	local char = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			pcall(function()
				print(hrp.Position)
				setclipboard(tostring(hrp.Position))
			end)
		end
	end
end
function checkposition()
	local split = string.split(textbox.Text, ",")
	local x = tonumber(split[1])
	local y = tonumber(split[2])
	local z = tonumber(split[3])
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "part position"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y, z)
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	part.Parent = workspace
end

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	pcall(getposition)
end)

button3.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for i, part in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name == "part position" then
			pcall(function()
				part:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
end)
